# Exit on error
set -e

# Pre-deployment validation: check required environment variables

#!/bin/bash

# deploy.sh - Creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e

# Pre-deployment validation: Check that all environment variables from .env.test are set
validate_environment() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: $env_file not found in current directory"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace from key
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Skip if key is empty after trimming
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
        
        # Check if variable is set and has a non-empty value
        if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Required environment variable '$key' is not set"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Check if value is empty (has only whitespace)
        if [[ -z "${!key// }" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Required environment variable '$key' has an empty value"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        echo "  ✓ $key is set"
    done < "$env_file"
    
    echo "Environment validation passed!"
}

# Run validation before proceeding
validate_environment

# Generate a timestamp for the archive name
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do

        if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then

        # Check if the value is empty or just whitespace
        if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: Environment variable '$key' has no value in .env.test"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Check if the variable is actually set in the environment
        if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: Environment variable '$key' is not set in the current environment"

        fi
        
        echo "  ✓ $key is set"

                exit 1
            fi
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    echo "All environment variables validated successfully."

# Function to send config to deployment orchestrator
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local orchestrator_url="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"
    
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found. Skipping config submission."
        return 0
    fi
    
    echo "Submitting configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Convert .env file to JSON format
    local json="{"
    local first=true
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Extract variable name and value
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$ ]]; then
            var_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            var_value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            
            # Add comma separator for multiple entries
            if [[ "$first" == true ]]; then
                first=false
            else
                json+=","
            fi
            
            # Escape special characters in value for JSON
            escaped_value="${var_value//\\/\\\\}"
            escaped_value="${escaped_value//\"/\\\"}"
            escaped_value="${escaped_value//$'\n'/\\n}"
            escaped_value="${escaped_value//$'\t'/\\t}"
            escaped_value="${escaped_value//$'\r'/\\r}"
            
            # Add to JSON
            json+="\"${var_name}\":\"${escaped_value}\""

    # Display the JSON being sent (excluding sensitive values if needed)

        response=$(curl -s -X POST \

            -d "$json" \
            "$orchestrator_url")
            
        echo "Orchestrator response: $response"
    elif command -v wget &> /dev/null; then
        response=$(wget -q -O - --post-data="$json" \
            --header="Content-Type: application/json" \
            "$orchestrator_url")
            
        echo "Orchestrator response: $response"
    else
        echo "Warning: Neither curl nor wget is available. Skipping config submission."
    fi
    
    echo "Configuration submission complete."
}

validate_env_vars

send_config_to_orchestrator

    [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script for creating release archives
# Pre-deployment validation ensures environment variables are set
# Archive excludes node_modules, .git, and deploy.sh

set -e  # Exit on error

# Function to validate environment variables from .env.test
validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found. Skipping environment variable validation."
        return 0
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace from key
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Skip if value is empty or only whitespace
        if [[ -z "$value" || "$value" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' is empty or missing in $env_file"
            return 1
        fi
        
        # Trim whitespace from value
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Check if the environment variable is actually set
        if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' is not set in the current environment"
            return 1
        fi
        
        echo "  ✓ $key is set"
    done < "$env_file"
    
    echo "All environment variables validated successfully!"
}

# Pre-deployment validation
echo "Running pre-deployment checks..."
validate_env_vars

# Get the current directory name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$PWD")

# Create a timestamp for the release
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)

# Define the archive filename
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Create the tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='deploy.sh' \
    -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" .

echo "Created release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo "Archive contents:"
tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | head -20
echo "..."
